sloka: प्रागेव चागता तत्र सुमित्रा लक्ष्मण स्तदा ।सीता चानायिता श्रुत्वा प्रियं रामाभिषेचनम् ॥२-४-३१॥
transliteration: prāgeva cāgatā tatra sumitrā lakṣmaṇa stadā ।sītā cānāyitā śrutvā priyaṁ rāmābhiṣecanam ॥2-4-31॥

translations.english: Hearing the welcome tidings of the installation of her beloved Rama, Sita too, had been brought in. Sumitra and Lakshmana had already arrived there.
